title: Choreo
description: Build two different autonomous paths with real constraints and confirm they generate correctly.

checkpoints.title: Paths have waypoints
checkpoints.description: Every path has at least four waypoints.

checkpoints.title: Two different paths
checkpoints.description: At least two paths exist, and they aren't just copies of each other.

checkpoints.title: Path has a constraint
checkpoints.description: The path has at least one enabled constraint (Max Velocity, Max Angular Velocity, or Keep In Rectangle).

checkpoints.title: Path generates
checkpoints.description: Choreo successfully solves the path into a trajectory.
